integrationBase.statement: R2 was replayed on top of the full current lineage after GLOBAL_SECONDARY transport, conclusion-correction separation, and explicit GLOBAL_SECONDARY replan evidence had all landed. The 79c144 parent is evidence-only relative to the a38f4cf implementation, so the resulting R2 source/tests/docs trees are byte-identical to the fully validated f599df9 composition.

architecture.methodLaw: Extract only boundaries already demonstrated by real R0/R1/P-C1 friction. Large function/store size alone is not an extraction criterion.
architecture.agentTurnProjectionOwner: AgentTurnProjector owns read-side construction of one exact Agent-visible turn: current WorkingView projection, exact selected pin refs, caller-ingress addressability, pre/caller/post transient Tool ordering, predecessor-attempt transient withdrawal, Runtime Tool inclusion and request-bound Harness capabilities plus exact remaining-budget projection.
architecture.cognitionAdmissionOwner: CognitionAdmissionKernel owns only the structural law shared by Agent-authored durable cognition mutations: reload current WorkingSet, require exact source digest still current, invoke the action-specific durable handler, and report selection change.
architecture.semanticSeparation: Caller promotion and ordinary WorkingSet transition remain distinct actions with distinct evidence/progress semantics in the sequential coordinator. Same-pin transition remains attempt reset rather than progress.
architecture.correctionSeparation: Tool correction and caller/domain conclusion correction remain independent authorities. AgentTurnProjector receives the already-computed remaining budget including both toolCorrections and conclusionCorrections; R2 does not merge, reinterpret or own either counter.
architecture.constructionVerificationSeparation: AgentTurnProjector constructs from read-side authorities. SQLiteHarnessRunContinuityStore remains unchanged by R2 and independently reconstructs the permitted WorkingView prefix, caller provenance, Tool exchange chronology, current pin ranges and exact request identity from Journal/CAS before Provider admission.
architecture.transportSeparation: The bounded loopback CONNECT implementation remains a Provider physical-transport concern and composes without entering Agent capability/cognition authority. Direct Provider behavior remains available when no proxy is projected.
architecture.stopRule: R2 stops at turn projection and cognition admission. Provider lifecycle, Tool-effect coordination and progress/control remain in the sequential coordinator until equivalent real execution friction proves a stronger boundary.
architecture.nonGoals: No SQLite schema, Protocol codec, public API, generic Capability/Memory service, semantic ranking, Provider routing policy or automatic transport migration was added by R2.

structuralMeasurements.semanticMergeFact: The concurrent conclusion-correction change added conclusion_corrections to remaining-budget construction. R2 preserved that authority by supplying it to AgentTurnProjector rather than restoring the removed inline AgentTurnRequest constructor.

deterministicBehavior.plainTurn: Non-projected turns preserve canonical messages/context and Runtime Tool definitions without inventing WorkingView authority.
deterministicBehavior.projectedOrdering: Projected turns preserve base WorkingView prefix followed by pre-caller Tool exchange, exact caller ingress and post-caller Tool exchange, with exact caller request positions and selected pin refs.
deterministicBehavior.projectionFailClosed: Projected-only refs/caller/transient inputs require a base WorkingView and fail closed otherwise.
deterministicBehavior.staleAttemptWithdrawal: Transient Tool exchanges from a predecessor WorkingSet attempt are excluded and the coordinator clears its process-local transient cache.
deterministicBehavior.dynamicPromotionCapability: Installed promotion remains distinct from current capability; promotion is true only while exact addressable caller refs survive projection.
deterministicBehavior.staleCognitionSource: CognitionAdmissionKernel rejects stale source WorkingSet identity before the durable action-specific handler is called.
deterministicBehavior.sameSelectionReset: Ordinary transition with identical pins remains lawful with selectionChanged=false.
deterministicBehavior.loopbackTransportContracts: Four bounded loopback transport contract tests pass: direct path unchanged without proxy, proxy variables must be unambiguous, CONNECT tunnels the fixed target, and only plain IPv4-loopback proxy endpoints are accepted.
deterministicBehavior.conclusionCorrectionContracts: Four conclusion-correction tests pass: independent exhaustion, no Tool-budget consumption, explicit Contract authority and schema-v1 default materialization.
deterministicBehavior.crossSurfaceBudgetProbe: A direct RunBudget probe with one Tool correction consumed and two conclusion corrections consumed returned toolCorrections=1 and conclusionCorrections=1 simultaneously, proving the two budgets remain independent after projection extraction.

conclusion: R2 is current on the complete Harness lineage containing bounded DeepSeek secondary egress, independent conclusion correction, and explicit GLOBAL_SECONDARY replan evidence. AgentTurnProjector owns exact read-side turn construction, CognitionAdmissionKernel owns common source-current cognition admission, tool/conclusion correction budgets remain independent, and SQLite Continuity remains an unchanged independent verifier. a983c1a has byte-identical src/tests/docs trees to fully validated f599df9, which passed 282 tests and real direct deepseek-v4-flash promotion/transition probes; the only lineage delta is inherited evidence metadata.
knownLimits: OrdivonAgentLoop._run remains roughly 1.97k lines. Remaining size is known debt, not sufficient evidence for another immediate extraction.
AgentTurnProjector and CognitionAdmissionKernel remain internal execution components rather than public APIs or global services.
Provider lifecycle, Tool effect/reconciliation, progress gates, conclusion validation and pause/stop assembly remain in the sequential Run coordinator.
Construction and Continuity verification intentionally retain separate algorithms as independent authorities.

The loopback syscall/policy-route and Finance conclusion-correction live proofs are inherited historical parent evidence; R2 revalidates their current contracts and real direct Provider composition without pretending to rerun those exact external experiments.
No Runtime, World, Finance, Host or other Ordivon repository was changed by R2.

The final lineage revision a983c1a was not subjected to a redundant second physical DeepSeek run because its src/tests/docs trees are Git-object-identical to the fully live-tested f599df9 revision; only parent evidence/index bytes differ.
